description: Investigator-assigned study identifier for the TB cohort (format TB-YYYY-NNN). Not itself a direct identifier; keep.
Patient's legal last name (PHI cat A -- direct identifier, HIPAA Safe Harbor requires removal or pseudonymization).
Patient's legal first name (PHI cat A -- direct identifier, remove or pseudonymize).
Social Security number, held locally by the site for death-index and disease-registry linkage prior to de-identification (PHI cat H -- direct identifier, remove).
Full date of birth (PHI cat C -- dates; Safe Harbor allows year only, month and day must be removed).
Residential street address (PHI cat B -- geographic subdivision smaller than state, remove).
Residential city (PHI cat B -- geographic subdivision smaller than state, remove).
Residential US state, two-letter postal abbreviation (Safe Harbor explicitly permits state-level geography; keep).

Residential 5-digit ZIP code (PHI cat B -- Safe Harbor allows only the first 3 digits, and only for a ZIP3 area with population > 20,000; the 17 HIPAA-restricted ZIP3 prefixes must be dropped entirely).
Age in years at TB disease onset, TB Portals' own field name (Safe Harbor allows ages under 90 as-is; ages 90 and over must be aggregated to '90+').
Sex recorded at birth -- 'Sex' in both RVCT and TB Portals (clinically needed demographic, not a Safe Harbor identifier; keep).
Race per OMB categories (clinically and epidemiologically needed; keep).
Hispanic or Latino ethnicity per OMB categories (clinically and epidemiologically needed; keep).
Country of birth. Foreign-born status is the dominant US TB epidemiology risk factor per CDC NTSS surveillance (clinically needed; keep).
Years of US residence for foreign-born patients; 'N/A' for US-born patients (RVCT field, clinically needed TB risk factor; keep).

Date the patient was registered into the TB program/surveillance system, ahead of confirmed diagnosis (PHI cat C -- dates; Safe Harbor allows year only). Modeled on TB Portals' 'Registration Date' field.
Date TB disease was confirmed, distinct from program registration and treatment start (PHI cat C -- dates; Safe Harbor allows year only).

WHO/RVCT case-registration category: New, Relapse, Treatment after failure, Treatment after loss to follow-up, or Transferred in. Modeled on TB Portals' 'Case Definition' field (clinically needed; keep).
ICD-10-CM tuberculosis diagnosis code (A15-A19 range), e.g. A15.0 pulmonary TB, A18.2 tuberculous peripheral lymphadenopathy. Modeled on TB Portals' 'Diagnosis Code' field (clinically needed; keep).
Anatomic site of TB disease: pulmonary, extrapulmonary (with site), or both. Equivalent to TB Portals' 'Localization' field (core clinical variable; keep).
Acid-fast bacilli sputum smear microscopy result; 'N/A' when the site of disease is exclusively extrapulmonary (clinical lab result; keep).
Mycobacterial culture result confirming M. tuberculosis (clinical lab result; keep).
Chest radiograph finding, e.g. cavitary or non-cavitary infiltrate, pleural effusion, or normal (clinical imaging result; keep).

Drug-susceptibility testing (DST) result summary, e.g. pan-susceptible, isoniazid-resistant, rifampin-resistant (RR-TB), or multidrug-resistant (MDR-TB). Equivalent to TB Portals' 'DST Profile' field (clinical lab result critical for treatment planning; keep).
HIV coinfection status, a standard RVCT/NTSS and TB Portals TB surveillance data element (clinical comorbidity; keep).

Non-HIV comorbidity most relevant to TB treatment and prognosis, e.g. diabetes mellitus, alcohol use disorder, chronic malnutrition, or none. Modeled on TB Portals' broader 'Comorbidity' field (clinically needed; keep).

Anti-TB drug regimen prescribed, e.g. first-line HRZE (isoniazid, rifampin, pyrazinamide, ethambutol) or a second-line MDR/RR-TB regimen. Modeled on TB Portals' 'Regimen Drugs' field (clinically needed; keep).
Date the anti-TB treatment regimen began (PHI cat C -- dates; Safe Harbor allows year only).
Date the treatment regimen ended (completion, death, or last contact before loss to follow-up); 'Ongoing' when the patient is still on treatment (PHI cat C -- dates; Safe Harbor allows year only).
Final treatment outcome: completed, died, lost to follow-up, or still on treatment. Equivalent to TB Portals' 'Outcome' field (core epidemiologic outcome variable; keep).
